195	        filesystem_events = [
196	            e
197	            for e in events
198	            if e.type == "FILESYSTEM"
199	            and "git_repos/.bbot_test/test_keys" in e.data["path"]
200	            and "git" in e.tags
201	            and e.scope_distance == 1
202	        ]
203	        assert 1 == len(filesystem_events), "Failed to git clone CODE_REPOSITORY"
204	        # make sure the binary blob isn't here
205	        assert not any("blob" in e.data for e in [e for e in events if e.type == "FILESYSTEM"])
206	        filesystem_event = filesystem_events[0]
207	        folder = Path(filesystem_event.data["path"])
208	        assert folder.is_dir(), "Destination folder doesn't exist"
209	        with open(folder / "keys.txt") as f:
210	            content = f.read()
211	            assert content == self.file_content, "File content doesn't match"
